release_read.basis: EPS $0.08 against a $0.05 bar and sales $66.9M against about $64.4M are a beat, but international exports were flat quarter on quarter at $20.8M (the export ramp the thesis leaned on did not accelerate), cannabis gross margin fell to 48% from 55% and adjusted EBITDA fell to $18.2M from $20.7M; the Q4 outlook (trim pricing normalising, Netherlands Phase II) is supportive but not numeric. A modest positive, well inside the 13.9% historical reaction.

release.headline: Village Farms Q3 2026 results, driven by record cannabis revenues

vs_bar.consensus_source: WebSearch summary of pre-report coverage (finviz preview), snippet_only
Nasdaq EPS forecast in the brief (fallback, 2 estimates)
no consensus found; +75% YoY but in line with the prior quarter

key_line.detail: Exports $20.8M, +75% YoY but flat sequentially; cannabis gross margin 48% vs 55% on a soft Canadian trim market; Canadian non-branded sales $3.3M vs $7.3M; adj. EBITDA $18.2M vs $20.7M.

guidance.detail: No numeric guide; expects trim pricing to normalise in Q4 under new supply contracts, Netherlands Phase II fully planted for stronger Q4 2026 and 2027 growth, Delta 2 done Q1 2027. Release time stated as 07:00 ET in the date announcement (snippet).

call.detail: Call scheduled 08:30 ET, so it was held before the open; its content was not reviewed in the time available. No call risk remains in the session.

public_reaction.summary: No time to search analyst actions or retail tone before compilation; none recorded.

tape_read.note: Robust reference 3.0546 is +6.06% vs the 2.88 prev close (range 2.977-3.10), 43 prints, 15 in the last 30 minutes, last at 09:16, not stale. That is about double the +3% the release supports, inside the 13.9% historical move; IWM +1.5% supplies part of it. Position is +4.1% vs entry.

thesis_check.note: Beat on sales and EPS as the thesis expected (bar under-modelled again), but the export line did not ramp sequentially and margin compressed, so the strongest part of the thesis is not confirmed.

expected.open_lag_note: Active, non-stale pre-market so the open should hold most of the +6%; a gap roughly twice what a mixed beat (flat exports, lower margin) supports, in a low-priced small cap, tends to give part of it back by 10:00, and the call is already behind us.

recommendation.reason: De cijfers zijn iets beter dan verwacht (winst en omzet), maar de export groeide niet verder en de marge daalde. De voorbeurs staat al ongeveer 6% hoger, ongeveer twee keer wat de cijfers rechtvaardigen; we verwachten dat een deel daarvan in de loop van de dag terugloopt, dus verkopen bij de opening en de winst van circa 4% vastzetten.
recommendation.what_would_change_it: Als de voorbeurskoers voor 09:30 terugzakt naar rond de 2,97 (circa +3%) of lager, is de overreactie weg en is vasthouden tot 13:00 volgens de vaste regel weer redelijk.

searched_and_found_nothing: analyst actions and retail tone not searched for lack of time
